verdict.rationale: Kong ships an official Go SDK for the Gateway Admin API (go-kong). It installs via `go get`, follows semantic versioning, runs integration tests against OSS and Enterprise, and publishes GoDoc. However, its Konnect Go SDK is explicitly labeled a prototype that "should not be used," and Kong publishes no supported general-purpose Konnect client SDK. Terraform providers, decK, and kongctl are adjacent tooling, not SDKs. missing for 10: a supported Konnect platform SDK, official SDKs in languages beyond Go (e.g. Python/TypeScript), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
